home.title: Which video are we cutting today?
home.lead: We listen to the whole thing on your computer and suggest the parts that work on their own.
home.no_projects: No projects yet. Drop a video to start.

placeholder.body: This screen arrives in the next step of version 0.1.

ffmpeg_missing.title: The video engine is missing
ffmpeg_missing.body: We couldn't find an ffmpeg build with subtitle support. Reinstall SnipScout or install full ffmpeg, then reopen the app.

unsupported_media.title: We can't open this file
unsupported_media.body: It isn't a supported video or audio file, or it's damaged. Try MP4, MOV, MKV, WEBM, MP3, WAV or M4A.

no_speech.title: We found no speech in this file
no_speech.body: There's only music or silence, so there are no sentences to make clips from.

model_download.title: The speech model couldn't be downloaded
model_download.body: Check your connection and try again. The download resumes where it stopped.

offline.title: You're in no-internet mode
offline.body: This needs a one-time download. Turn off no-internet mode and try again.

ffmpeg_failed.title: We couldn't create the video
ffmpeg_failed.body: The video engine failed on this part. Copy the technical details if you want to report it.

cancelled.title: Cancelled
cancelled.body: Everything done so far has been saved.

project_not_found.title: We can't find this project
project_not_found.body: It may have been deleted. Go back to the start to see your projects.

storage.title: We couldn't save your data
storage.body: The disk may be full or read-only. Free up space and try again.

job_busy.title: We're already working on this
job_busy.body: Wait for it to finish or cancel it before starting again.

bad_request.title: Something doesn't add up
bad_request.body: Check the values and try again.

unauthorized.title: Open SnipScout from its window
unauthorized.body: This page only works when opened from the app.

server_unreachable.title: The app isn't responding
server_unreachable.body: Close SnipScout and open it again.

unknown.title: Something went wrong
unknown.body: Copy the technical details if you want to report it.
